asr.full_text: Before we jump into the video, take a look at how much I earned in just a few minutes. If you want to profit from flashloans, without coding or how to get the highest APY on the. Market, then this video should help you. Though beware, most videos on YouTube are actually scams,. Or no longer work. This is the only flashloan bot that has worked for me so far. If you stick around to the end, I'll show you how to join a massive airdrop,. You definitely don't want to miss. Before I found this platform, I had tested many other platforms, deploying smart contracts and flash loans, though most didn't work for me. All you need to get started, is a wallet such as Metamask or Trust Wallet, as well as Ether or BNB to cover the gas fees. In this video, I'm using Ether, but BNB works. Make sure to select the correct network on Metamask. As you can see earlier, I used a flash loan to make a nice profit, only paying 0.2 Ether for the gas fees. To make sure you're on the correct website, check the domain name is arbitrageflashloan.github.io. This is the only working platform right now that offers codeless flash loans. To get started, click on the menu icon then click on the token list link. Click on the ERC20 button if you are using Ether, otherwise click BEP20 to use Binance Smart Chain. Now you'll be taken to the official Token Tracker page, where you can find the contract address for the token you want to make an arbitrage trade on. I'm going to use Uniswap token as an example. Now you copy the token address, and remember its ticker. We can now close the token tracker page, and go back to the Flashbot homepage. Paste the token address into the address box, and then type the ticker into the token symbol text box. Then click on the Start Arbitrage Finder button. Wait a moment while the website finds the best arbitrage opportunity, as well as the perfect pair rooting for the selected token, in order to make the most profit. Now we have to choose how much Ether we want to get to use on the flash loan. As you can see, if I decrease the flash loan amount the ROI will decrease a lot, because of the risk of getting front run by other arbitrage flash loans. Usually 0.2 Ether and 0.3 BNB gives the best results, this way I never get front run and I get better ROI. When you have selected your loan amount, click on the deposit button. Confirm the MetaMask transaction. Wait until the transaction is confirmed by the blockchain then click on the. Execute button and then confirm the transaction wait again for the. Confirmation of the transaction. Now the platform has executed the arbitrage trade and paid back the flash. Loan you will receive the profit on your wallet. As you can see, I made more than 11 Ether with this one trade I made. That's not bad for a couple minutes. Now feel free to try yourself, or stay to learn about the airdrop they're doing, and how to take part in it. The first part is to stake in one of the FlashBot pools, not only will you get the airdrop,. But you will also generate profits from FlashLoan arbitrage on autopilot. Ok, let me show and explain how to stake your Ether and BNB, first open the pool page by. Clicking on the menu link then click on the pool you want to join and click. Approve as you can see the APY is high you have. To remember the minimum deposit is 0.3 ether or 1 BNB now we insert the amount. We want to stake and click approve. I staked all the ether I had from the flash loan earlier but I kept some to. Cover the gas fees. When the transaction has been completed, we'll start earning from the pool as you can see. When it's confirmed, refresh and it will show you your earnings. I decided to speed up the next minute to show you how much I'm earning. We can also go claim the airdrop now. Click the Claim Airdrop button at the top, to get redirected to the airdrop page. All we have to do is click Claim, to receive a 10% airdrop of whatever you staked in the pools. When you have claimed the airdrop, you can even withdraw your stake from the pool if you want. Let me show you how. As you can see, I just received 1.46 Ether from the airdrop. To withdraw from the pool, just go back to the pools page. Click on withdraw, and sign the transaction, you will get your stake as well as the profits. That's it, you can see how much I made from the air drop, and the pool stake. Thanks for watching. If this helped, please comment, like and subscribe. You. You. Thank you.

evidence.observation: The speaker attributes a claimed return of more than 11 Ether to one trade.

evidence.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to participate in a FlashBot pool.
